subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: For provider aliases in Control UI usage/session surfaces, should the UI show only the canonical provider id, or show the canonical id with the configured alias as secondary context?
rationale: The source fix is clear, but the product contract affects visible labels, query/filter values, CSV output, aggregate keys, and how users reconcile UI labels with their openclaw.json aliases.

options.title: Canonical primary plus alias context
options.body: Use canonical ids for keys, filtering, exports, and primary labels while optionally showing the configured alias as a tooltip or secondary detail where visible.

options.title: Canonical only everywhere
options.body: Normalize all display, query, export, and aggregate provider values to canonical ids and do not surface the configured alias in the Control UI.

options.title: Preserve raw configured labels
options.body: Keep raw configured provider ids in display/export paths and treat internal canonical ids as implementation-only behavior.

recommendation.title: Canonical primary plus alias context
recommendation.body: Use canonical ids for keys, filtering, exports, and primary labels while optionally showing the configured alias as a tooltip or secondary detail where visible.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent model-catalog and Control UI usage history and is the strongest available owner for the product-facing alias-display contract.
